summaries.Romania: Romania faces security challenges with drone attacks on commercial shipping in the Black Sea and uncertainty over Russian oil imports through its ports, while political tensions simmer over electoral transparency and administrative reform. Healthcare and education sectors show innovation with residency exam results announced and older adults returning to university.
summaries.Healthcare: Apple and OpenEvidence launched a major AI health study recruiting 200,000 participants, while healthcare systems continue consolidating and investing in AI-powered clinical workflows despite regulatory and payer pressures on margins.
summaries.Tech: Nvidia faces major leadership turmoil with Jensen Huang's exit and potential return bid overshadowing the company's dominance in AI chips, while Apple prepares smart glasses for 2027 launch and SpaceX achieves a historic Starship recovery milestone.

items.title: HLTH26: Apple launches 200K-person study to examine how consumers use health AI
items.snippet: Apple launched the Apple Health AI Usage Study today with plans to recruit 200,000 participants in the U.S. to gain a better understanding of how people interact with conversational health AI tools.
items.line: Apple's 200,000-person health AI usage study directly addresses how consumers interact with conversational health tools, a key growth vector for Apple Health ecosystem.

items.title: Dyania Health, Nvidia team up to bring clinical reasoning AI inside hospital networks
